[theme[template]]
<style id="ccoder-public-theme">
.public-flow-section > .public-section-frame {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.public-flow-section.public-banner-deep > .public-section-frame {
  background: #142a48;
  border: 0;
}

.public-flow-section.public-banner-blue > .public-section-frame {
  background: #0e6fae;
  border: 0;
}

.public-banner .public-hero-copy .site-kicker,
.public-banner > .public-section-frame > .site-kicker {
  color: #8fd4ff;
}

.public-banner .public-hero-copy .public-hero-title,
.public-banner .public-hero-copy .public-copy {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.public-flow-section .public-card,
.public-flow-section .public-hero-list,
.public-flow-section .accordion .accordion-item {
  border-color: rgba(20, 42, 72, .16);
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(20, 42, 72, .07);
}

.public-flow-section .public-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(82, 188, 255, .55);
}

.public-feature-card {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.public-article {
  width: min(100%, 900px);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.public-domain-article {
  width: min(100%, 1180px);
  max-width: 1180px;
}

.public-domain-article pre {
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin: 1rem 0 1.75rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(20, 42, 72, .16);
  border-left: 4px solid #0e6fae;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #f7fbfe;
  color: #10263a;
}

.public-domain-article pre code {
  white-space: pre;
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent;
}

.public-domain-article pre code {
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.language-csharp .syntax-comment { color: #587287; font-style: italic; }
.language-csharp .syntax-string { color: #8a3d12; }
.language-csharp .syntax-keyword { color: #6542a6; font-weight: 700; }
.language-csharp .syntax-number { color: #096b65; }
.language-csharp .syntax-type { color: #0a6680; font-weight: 600; }

.public-content-page {
  width: min(100%, 1180px);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.public-content-page .public-section-frame {
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;
}

.public-content-page .public-article,
.public-content-page .public-domain-article {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1180px;
}

.public-content-page .public-copy,
.public-content-page .public-page p,
.public-content-page p,
.public-content-page li,
.public-content-page .docs-sidebar-copy,
.public-content-page .public-section-heading {
  max-width: none;
}









</style>
